content.short: Loofta is a Web3 freelance and creator marketplace on TON connecting projects with influencers.
content.description: Loofta is a comprehensive decentralized marketplace designed to connect Web3 projects with a global network of freelancers and content creators. Operating on the TON blockchain, Loofta provides robust tools for campaign management, secure escrow-based payments, and verified creator profiles. By facilitating transparent and efficient collaborations, Loofta helps projects scale their marketing efforts while empowering creators to find high-quality opportunities and receive instant payments in Toncoin and stablecoins, fostering a professional gig economy on TON.
content.meta: Hire creators or find Web3 work on Loofta. The premier TON freelance marketplace on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
